title: Wheat
description: Bulk supply of milling wheat and feed wheat sourced from major Black Sea grain producing regions.
overview:
AFGT trades milling-grade wheat and feed wheat sourced from major grain-producing regions across the Black Sea corridor. The company coordinates procurement, logistics, and vessel-scale deliveries for international buyers, flour mills, and agricultural distributors.

All wheat shipments are supplied with full documentation including phytosanitary certificates, SGS inspection reports, and quality analysis covering protein content, moisture levels, and grain specifications.
